escalation.reason: Cheongpung is the one who might pull an ear out of curiosity upon seeing a royal for the first time; 귀 refers to the royal’s ear, not Cheongpung’s.

findings.explanation: The speaker fears Cheongpung might pull the royal's ear out of curiosity, not his own.
findings.korean: 황족 처음 봐서 신기하다고 귀라도 잡아당기면
